Key concentrated exposures are InvestAcc Group £47.8m (32.5% of NAV), Zegona Communications £34.8m (23.7% of NAV), AdvancedAdvT £26.7m (18.2% of NAV) and Le Chameau £23.9m (16.2% of NAV). NAVs for the 2016 Realisation Share and 2021 Realisation Share are £4.191 and £3.049 respectively.
